task: JS-150; PRODUCT.md; supersedes D-027 and D-033 as D-089 records
brief: The owner's direction after reading D-087.
tradeoff: None stated by the owner; D-089 states what is given up.
entry: The owner: "JellyScale is not a desktop client. JellyScale is the back end scalable [API]. Octave is the front end. So Octave will run in the web, on a TV, and natively on device. JellyScale should consider the user experience of Octave, since Octave is the primary client that will ship with JellyScale. So instead of Jellyfin Web, it will ship with Octave." And: "Octave will also support rendering a QR code for quick connect."
serves: PRODUCT.md, whose wording the owner is still to approve.
